title.zh: HTX’s proof of reserves doesn’t match its blockchain balances
title.en: HTX’s proof of reserves doesn’t match its blockchain balances

current_state.zh: HTX's September proof of reserves misstates on-chain balances, claiming 360,949.90 USDS at an address that held zero USDS at the cited block height and overstating USDD holdings by roughly 89,772 tokens.
